MERMAID + CSS REFERENCE VARIANT

結帳流程 · 系統分組版

flowchart TB
  subgraph CLIENT["前端"]
    UI(["Vue SPA
送出結帳"])
  end
  subgraph APP["結帳服務"]
    direction LR
    ORDER["建立訂單
價格快照・保留庫存"]
    PAY["發起付款
不持有資料庫鎖"]
    ORDER --> PAY
  end
  subgraph GATEWAY["外部金流"]
    direction LR
    GW["Mock Gateway"]
    RESULT{"付款結果"}
    GW --> RESULT
  end
  subgraph DATA["資料庫"]
    DB[("PostgreSQL
orders・payments・events")]
  end
  UI --> ORDER
  PAY -->|charge| GW
  RESULT -->|確認付款成功| DB
  class UI client
  class ORDER,PAY,RESULT app
  class DB data
  class GW external
  class CLIENT client
  class APP app
  class DATA data
  class GATEWAY external

來源是 Mermaid；虛線系統框與元件視覺由 CSS 套用。此圖只保留成功主路徑，付款失敗或結果不明則維持 PENDING，交由後續查詢與對帳處理。
